texto.en: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
texto.es: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

texto.en: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air,
texto.es: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air,

texto.en: upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

texto.en: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

texto.en: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man;

texto.en: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
texto.es: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.

texto.en: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward,

texto.en: and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.
texto.es: and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.

texto.en: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
texto.es: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.

texto.en: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
texto.es: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

texto.en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
texto.es: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

texto.en: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

texto.en: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
texto.es: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

texto.en: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
texto.es: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.

texto.en: So what does this chapter mean? Here are three simple ideas.
texto.es: ¿Y qué quiere decir este capítulo? Acá van tres ideas simples.

texto.en: First: God makes a promise to Noah, to his family, and to every living creature. The promise is for all of them.
texto.es: Primera: Dios hace una promesa a Noé, a su familia y a todo ser vivo. La promesa es para todos.

texto.en: Second: the bow in the clouds is a sign. The text says God will look at it and remember the promise.
texto.es: Segunda: el arco en las nubes es una señal. El texto dice que Dios lo mirará y recordará la promesa.

texto.en: Third: the story is honest about people. Even after the flood, Noah and his family are not perfect.
texto.es: Tercera: el relato es honesto sobre las personas. Incluso después del diluvio, Noé y su familia no son perfectos.

texto.en: One more thing: in the original Hebrew, a few words say even more.
texto.es: Una cosa más: en el hebreo original, algunas palabras dicen todavía más.

texto.en: The word for covenant is brit. It means a solemn promise, one that two sides can count on.
texto.es: La palabra para pacto es brit. Significa una promesa solemne, en la que ambas partes pueden confiar.

texto.en: The word for bow is qeshet. It is also the word for a warrior's bow, a weapon. Here it is hung up in the sky.
texto.es: La palabra para arco es qeshet. Es también la palabra para el arco de un guerrero, un arma. Aquí queda colgado en el cielo.

texto.en: And "replenish" translates male, which means to fill. The family is told to fill the earth again.
texto.es: Y «llenad» traduce male, que significa llenar. A la familia se le dice que vuelva a llenar la tierra.

texto.en: Noah's family is ready to fill the earth again. What happens to all those families next?
texto.es: La familia de Noé está lista para llenar la tierra otra vez. ¿Qué pasará con todas esas familias?

texto.en: Next time: Genesis, Chapter 10. The families of the earth.
texto.es: La próxima vez: Génesis, capítulo 10. Las familias de la tierra.

texto.en: Thank you for reading the Bible with me, one chapter at a time.
texto.es: Gracias por leer la Biblia conmigo, un capítulo a la vez.
